notes: minimumScore is deliberately null: the ratchet RECORDS instead of gating until a full, unbudgeted shard matrix has run in CI and its number can be read off real artifacts. A complete local run (Windows, net10.0, 132 mutants) scored 84.09 percent - 105 killed, 6 timed out, 21 survived, 0 errored - which is recorded here as orientation ONLY and must not be copied into minimumScore: a local single-machine run is not the population the CI matrix measures. The surviving 21 are overwhelmingly equivalent mutants (Int32.MaxValue saturation guards, the true constant a short-circuiting || pushes, no-op boundary shifts in the raw-byte eviction loop), which is why the reachable ceiling sits well below 100 percent. Scope and score are one document on purpose - the score only means something relative to the mutant set it was computed over, so widening includeTypes and moving the baseline has to be a single reviewable diff.
